recognize_zh: 這是血紅素 HPLC 層析圖與峰值表（非形態學圖片），主峰 A0 佔 80.5%、HbA2 2.7%、HbF <0.8%，無異常變異峰，屬正常型態；但要注意 HPLC 正常並不排除以超活體染色才看得到的後天性 HbH。
features: Cation-exchange HPLC chromatogram with a dominant A0 peak at retention time 1.79 min (80.5%)
HbA2 peak at 3.30 min quantified at 2.7% (within normal range)
Glycated/minor fractions A1a, A1b, LA1c, A1c (6.8%) and P3 (5.4%) present; two small unknown peaks (0.8% and 0.6%)
No abnormal variant peaks such as HbS, HbE/A2 window elevation or early fast-eluting peaks
describe_en: Hemoglobin HPLC chromatogram with peak table shows a dominant HbA (A0) peak comprising 80.5% of total area, HbA2 of 2.7% and HbF below 0.8%. Minor glycated and adduct fractions (A1a, A1b, LA1c, A1c 6.8%, P3) and two small unidentified peaks under 1% are present, without a variant hemoglobin peak or elevated HbA2 or HbF. This is a normal hemoglobin fraction pattern, arguing against beta-thalassemia trait and common structural variants. Because HbH and small amounts of fast-eluting hemoglobins may be unretained or poorly resolved on this program, a normal result does not exclude acquired HbH disease, which is better demonstrated by supravital staining for HbH inclusions.

ddx.vs: Beta-thalassemia trait shows HbA2 typically >3.5% with microcytosis, unlike the 2.7% here.
HbH appears as a fast-eluting peak near the injection point or may be missed, with HbA2 often low, so HbH inclusion staining or alpha-globin genetic testing is needed.

ddx.dx: Hereditary persistence of fetal hemoglobin or delta-beta thalassemia
ddx.vs: These show markedly increased HbF, whereas HbF here is <0.8%.
